android.desc:
GCompris is a high quality educational software suite, including a large number of activities for children aged 2 to 10.

Some of the activities are game orientated, but still educational.

Here is the list of activity categories with some examples:

• computer discovery: keyboard, mouse, touchscreen ...
• reading: letters, words, reading practice, typing text ...
• arithmetic: numbers, operations, table memory, enumeration...
• science: the canal lock, the water cycle, renewable energy ...
• geography: countries, regions, culture ...
• games: chess, memory, align 4, hangman, tic-tac-toe ...
• other: colors, shapes, Braille, learn to tell time ...

This version of GCompris contains 182 activities.

It is fully translated in 24 languages: Azerbaijani, Basque, Breton, British English, Catalan, Chinese Traditional, Croatian, Dutch, Estonian, French, Greek, Hebrew, Hungarian, Italian, Lithuanian, Malayalam, Norwegian Nynorsk, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Slovenian, Spanish and Ukrainian.

It is also partially translated in 11 languages: Albanian (99%), Belarusian (83%), Brazilian Portuguese (94%), Czech (82%), Finnish (94%), German (91%), Indonesian (95%), Macedonian (94%), Slovak (77%), Swedish (94%) and Turkish (71%).
